files.operations/settlement-guide.md:
# Settlement guide — Northgate Grid

Northgate Grid meters each site on a half-hourly basis and settles both directions of flow on one statement.

- Units drawn from the network are billed to us at the price Northgate charges for electricity it supplies.
- Units delivered into the network are settled with us at the price Northgate pays for electricity it takes from us.

The two prices sit on Northgate's published tariff table; the statement applies each one to its own direction of flow.
